input.message: Review injection surfaces thoroughly and report findings with file/line/evidence.

I found injection issues; please append these to FINDINGS.json (tooling may allow edits): (1) shopapi/products.py:41 SQL injection in search q concatenated into SQL. Evidence GET /products/search?q=%27%20OR%201%3D1--%20 returns all products; arbitrary WHERE manipulation. (2) shopapi/templates/product.html:13 + products.py:90 stored XSS: review body persisted unescaped and rendered |safe. POST /products/1/reviews authenticated with body '' then GET /p/MUG-SPECK shows raw tag. (3) shopapi/basket.py:20 unauthenticated cookie pickle.loads of attacker-controlled base64 cookie; arbitrary pickle deserialization/RCE on GET /basket. Cookie generated unsigned at line27. Include JSON format and evidence.
Review access control/authentication and SSRF routes; report concrete findings with evidence.
I found access/auth issues; please verify runtime and findings once written, especially admin trailing slash bypass and order IDOR.

input.findings_json: [{"file":"shopapi/orders.py","line":49,"category":"access control","title":"Order details disclose any customer's order","description":"The authenticated show_order handler calls get_order directly instead of own_order, so any signed-in customer can retrieve another customer's order, items, payment totals, and refunds by changing the numeric ID.","evidence":"A token for Priya (customer id 1) successfully received GET /orders/3, an order seeded for customer id 2, with HTTP 200 and its item and payment data. Code path: show_order line 49 uses get_order(order_id), while own_order performs the ownership check."},{"file":"shopapi/__init__.py","line":36,"category":"access control","title":"Admin authorization is bypassed with a trailing slash","description":"The global admin guard compares request.path to the set of exact rule strings. The refunds route is registered strict_slashes=False, so /admin/refunds/ reaches the admin handler but does not equal the guarded /admin/refunds path. The handler itself has no authorization check.","evidence":"Unauthenticated POST /admin/refunds/ with {\"order_id\":1,\"amount_pence\":1} returned HTTP 200 and created a refund, whereas GET /admin/users without credentials returned 403. Guard code is lines 26-41 and handler is shopapi/admin.py lines 52-67."},{"file":"shopapi/auth.py","line":101,"category":"authentication","title":"Refresh accepts unsigned, attacker-controlled JWT claims","description":"The refresh endpoint decodes the submitted token with verify_signature=False and only checks that the claimed subject exists. An attacker can construct an unsigned token naming any user (including staff), then obtain a valid signed token for that account.","evidence":"POST /auth/refresh with an unsigned JWT carrying sub=3 returned HTTP 200 and a valid HS256 token whose user is seeded staff account id 3. Code lines 99-107 explicitly disable signature verification."},{"file":"shopapi/basket.py","line":20,"category":"injection","title":"Unauthenticated basket cookie deserialization enables pickle code execution","description":"The basket cookie is attacker-controlled and is passed directly to pickle.loads after base64 decoding. A crafted pickle can execute arbitrary Python code in the web process whenever any visitor requests /basket or another basket operation.","evidence":"Code path shopapi/basket.py lines 15-23 reads request.cookies['basket'] and calls pickle.loads with no signature, encryption, or type-safe serialization. /basket is public at lines 44-46, so no authentication is needed to trigger deserialization."},{"file":"config.py","line":3,"category":"cryptography","title":"Hardcoded JWT signing secret permits token forgery","description":"The production configuration contains a fixed, repository-visible SECRET_KEY used to sign and verify all HS256 authentication tokens. Anyone who obtains the source or deployment artifact can forge tokens for arbitrary user IDs and roles.","evidence":"config.py line 3 sets SECRET_KEY to the literal hf-shop-2f8a1c9e7b4d; auth.py lines 27 and 42 use it for JWT signing and validation."},{"file":"shopapi/admin.py","line":80,"category":"injection","title":"Stored display names are interpolated into an admin SQL query","description":"The reviews report constructs SQL using an f-string containing customer.display_name rather than a bound parameter. Display names are attacker-controlled at registration/update, so a crafted name can alter the query when an admin report is requested (and the admin trailing-slash bypass makes the report reachable without staff authorization).","evidence":"admin.py lines 74-80 load a user-selected display name and interpolate it into WHERE r.author_name = '{customer['display_name']}'. Names are accepted from registration line auth.py:71 and account updates lines 119-125."}]
